_README: Manifest for tools/agentic-sync/port.mjs, which GENERATES the OpenAI Codex CLI surface from the canonical .claude/ tree: .agents/skills/<name>/ (byte-exact mirrors), .codex/agents/<name>.toml and .codex/hooks.json. Never hand-edit a generated file — edit the .claude/ source and run `node tools/agentic-sync/port.mjs --write`. CI gate: scripts/check-codex-port.sh. Contracts were verified against openai/codex at tag rust-v0.144.1 (docs/guides/codex-cli-support-matrix.md cites each one). Every hook event and every hook script wired in .claude/settings.json must be EITHER portable OR named below with a reason; an unlisted one fails the generator, so the 26-of-39 drift that quarantined the first port (#9745) cannot recur silently.

independent.game-engine: exists on both sides as a real directory and the two have drifted; which side is canonical is undecided, so neither is overwritten. Tracked by #10131 — empty this list there
independent.kanban: exists on both sides as a real directory and the two have drifted; which side is canonical is undecided, so neither is overwritten. Tracked by #10131 — empty this list there
independent.web-accessibility: exists on both sides as a real directory and the two have drifted; which side is canonical is undecided, so neither is overwritten. Tracked by #10131 — empty this list there

handAuthored.code-architect: the Architect reviewer is the feature-dev:code-architect PLUGIN agent; there is no .claude/agents source file to generate from

droppedFrontmatterKeys.model: a Claude model alias (sonnet, opus); omitted so the agent inherits the Codex session's model
droppedFrontmatterKeys.memory: Claude Code agent memory scope; Codex has no per-agent memory
droppedFrontmatterKeys.isolation: Claude Code worktree isolation for the agent; Codex has no equivalent key
droppedFrontmatterKeys.tools: a Claude Code tool ALLOW-LIST. Codex has no per-agent tool restriction, so a read-only reviewer is read-only by instruction only — recorded in docs/guides/codex-cli-support-matrix.md
droppedFrontmatterKeys.skills: skills preloaded for the agent under Claude Code; under Codex the agent invokes a skill by name
droppedFrontmatterKeys.mcpServers: per-agent MCP server selection; Codex agents see the session's servers
droppedFrontmatterKeys.maxTurns: Claude Code turn cap; no Codex key
droppedFrontmatterKeys.hooks: agent-scoped Claude Code hooks (e.g. block-writes.sh on the read-only reviewers). Codex has no agent-scoped hooks, so that enforcement is ABSENT for Codex agents — recorded in the support matrix

droppedHandlerKeys.async: Codex skips a handler marked async outright (hooks/src/engine/discovery.rs: 'async hooks are not supported yet'), so copying the key would un-wire the hook. It is dropped and the hook runs synchronously, bounded by its own `timeout` and by its group's `if` condition, which the adapter applies. Today that is only post-push-resolve-comments.sh: up to 30s, after a command containing `git push`

unsupportedEvents.TaskCreated: no Codex hook event; task metadata is validated by the taskboard and by scripts, not at creation time
unsupportedEvents.TaskCompleted: no Codex hook event; ticket completion is checked by .claude/hooks/on-stop.sh, which IS wired to Stop
unsupportedEvents.StopFailure: no Codex hook event; rate-limit backoff is advisory context only
unsupportedEvents.ConfigChange: no Codex hook event; Codex reviews hook changes itself (every changed hook loses its trusted_hash until re-approved in /hooks)
unsupportedEvents.InstructionsLoaded: no Codex hook event; the same context is reachable from .codex/AGENTS.md
unsupportedEvents.WorktreeCreate: no Codex hook event; after `git worktree add`, pipe `{"worktree_path": …}` into .claude/hooks/worktree-setup.sh from the main checkout — .codex/AGENTS.md has the exact command (run bare, the script does nothing)
unsupportedEvents.SessionEnd: not among the events codex-cli 0.144.1 accepts (config/src/hook_config.rs); an unknown event key is silently ignored, so wiring it would do nothing. on-stop.sh already runs on Stop, so nothing is lost. Re-check this list against hook_config.rs whenever the supported Codex version is raised
unsupportedEvents.PostToolUseFailure: no Codex hook event; rate-limit backoff is advisory context only

skipScripts.restore-context-hints.sh: exists only to put context back in front of the model after compaction. Codex's PostCompact output accepts neither additionalContext nor any hookSpecificOutput (hooks/src/schema.rs, PostCompactCommandOutputWire, deny_unknown_fields) and drops plain stdout, so under Codex it could run and change nothing. Not wired rather than wired-and-inert
skipScripts.inject-post-compact.sh: same as restore-context-hints.sh: a PostCompact context injector, and Codex's PostCompact cannot carry context to the model. Compensating control: .codex/AGENTS.md instructs the agent to re-read .claude/rules/lessons-learned.md after a compaction — an instruction, not enforcement
skipScripts.auto-approve-safe-commands.sh: its whole output is permissionDecision=allow, which Codex rejects as unsupported (the hook run is marked Failed). Codex has no hook-driven approval; approvals come from approval_policy and the sandbox
